title: The executive summary: one page with finding, impact and next step

videos.script: Most of the people who decide what happens to your analysis will never see your presentation. {{never}} Renata was not in the meeting. The board meets next quarter. Paulo will forward your work to his own director with one line on top. {{forward}} What travels is a page. If you do not write it, somebody else will, in an email, from memory, and it will say less than you found. {{page}} So you write it yourself. One page, with three blocks. What you found. What it means in money, customers or risk. And what you want done next, by whom and by when. {{three}} This lesson writes Faro's page block by block, and then shows it whole. {{whole}}
